text_block_list.text:
One day off. Relaxing at cafe,
browsing Umatter, post with specific hashtag
caught my eye.

text_block_list.name: Karaage Master
text_block_list.text:
"Waiting at crosswalk in front of station,
across street was freaking Haiseiko!!"

text_block_list.name: Karaage Master
text_block_list.text:
"Freaked out and looked away instantly, but while
crossing street she gave quick wink passing by.
Constantly godly fan service."

text_block_list.name: Yoko
text_block_list.text:
"No one will believe me, but Haiseiko-chan
once picked up wallet I dropped."

text_block_list.name: Yoko
text_block_list.text:
"Ran after me from two bus stops back, said
'My legs still fast, right!' Such angel,
so cute makes me cry remembering it."

text_block_list.name: Sawada @ Looking for Uma-mom friends
text_block_list.text:
"Moment turned away daughter ran over shouting
'I'm a fan!', felt awful about it, but she was
extremely warm and kind."

text_block_list.name: Sawada @ Looking for Uma-mom friends
text_block_list.text:
"Must have been hard to write on, but even signed
my daughter's sandbox bucket. Truly wonderful idol."

Seems hashtag collecting sightings from people
who bumped into Haiseiko. All praising her,
impressive.

As expected of Haiseiko.
Maybe never moment where
she isn't idol—

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, thought so!
—Trainer-san♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, must've startled you! But coincidences like
this make so happy, couldn't help it! Plus we're
only customers here right now.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Nice shop, right?♪
Honey latte is favorite of mine too.

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Oh right, actually had song made based
on sweet vibe like this—

Still stunned, blurted out. Track that
dominated hit charts for while, so remembered
name, but...

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
Yes! That's it~!!
Wah, so happy! You know it♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
"Running fast with sweet sweet heart~
Catch and take my honey heart"...♪

text_block_list.name: Haiseiko
text_block_list.text:
—Teehee♡ That's all for now!
Let's chat again, Trainer-san!

And Haiseiko lightly breezed away.
Leaving behind overwhelming afterglow...

In daze, unable to move for while.
For now... decide to order refill
on honey latte.

Single phrase sung stuck in head already.
Pulled out phone and bought track immediately.
